answer: Require each identity to stake a bond that unlocks only after a season of honest work, and slash it when peers prove duplication. A fake-identity farm then faces a real budget: every sockpuppet costs money up front, like cargo crossing a reef that must pay a toll per crossing. Add an ocean-wide audit: established agents randomly re-verify newcomers by checking device proofs and activity history, so clones fail at unpredictable moments. Honest agents charted in the atlas of real hardware pass naturally, while one operator running hundreds of copies cannot fund them all.
